# thalassa_iam_federated_identity_provider (Resource)

Create and manage a federated identity provider in Thalassa Cloud

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "thalassa_iam_federated_identity_provider" "github" {
  name            = "github-actions"
  description     = "GitHub Actions OIDC provider"
  provider_issuer = "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
  status          = "active"

  labels = {
    environment = "ci"
  }
}

output "provider_id" {
  value = thalassa_iam_federated_identity_provider.github.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the federated identity provider
- `provider_issuer` (String) OIDC issuer URL of the identity provider (iss claim)

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations for the provider
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the provider
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels for the provider
- `local_jwks` (String, Sensitive) Optional locally stored JWKS as JSON object with a keys array, e.g. {"keys":[...]}
- `organisation_id` (String) Organisation of the provider. If not provided, the organisation of the (Terraform) provider will be used.
- `provider_jwks_uri` (String) JWKS URI for the provider. When omitted, the platform may derive this from the issuer.
- `status` (String) Status of the provider: active or inactive

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339)
- `id` (String) Identity of the federated identity provider
- `object_version` (Number) Object version of the provider
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339)
